---
title: "Wedding Accommodation Lookup"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r setup}
library(readr)
library(DT)

# Load the data
accom <- read_csv("accommodation.csv")
```

## Find Your Room

Type your **first name** into the search bar below to see where you're staying and what it costs.

```{r room-lookup, echo=FALSE}
datatable(
  accom,
  options = list(pageLength = 10),
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top"
)
```
